benefitDescription.en: ₹6,000/year in 3 instalments of ₹2,000 each

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Must own cultivable land. Institutional landholders, tax payers, and professionals excluded.

benefitDescription.en: ₹1.20 lakh one-time grant for house construction in plains (₹1.30 lakh in hilly/difficult areas)
benefitDescription.hi: मैदानी क्षेत्रों में मकान निर्माण के लिए ₹1.20 लाख एकमुश्त अनुदान (पहाड़ी/कठिन क्षेत्रों में ₹1.30 लाख)

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Must be houseless or living in kutcha/dilapidated house. Selected from SECC 2011 data.

benefitDescription.en: Interest subsidy up to ₹2.67 lakh on home loan for EWS/LIG categories
benefitDescription.hi: EWS/LIG श्रेणियों के लिए होम लोन पर ₹2.67 लाख तक ब्याज सब्सिडी

eligibility.additionalCriteria: EWS (income up to ₹3L) or LIG (income up to ₹6L). Must not own a pucca house.

benefitDescription.en: ₹5 lakh/year free health insurance cover per family for secondary & tertiary hospitalization
benefitDescription.hi: प्रति परिवार ₹5 लाख/वर्ष मुफ्त स्वास्थ्य बीमा कवर

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Families identified in SECC 2011 database. No cap on family size.

benefitDescription.en: Free LPG connection (₹1,600 subsidy) + first refill free for BPL households
benefitDescription.hi: बीपीएल परिवारों के लिए मुफ्त एलपीजी कनेक्शन (₹1,600 सब्सिडी) + पहला रिफिल मुफ्त

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Adult woman from BPL household. No existing LPG connection in the household.

benefitDescription.en: Savings scheme for girl child with 8.2% interest rate (tax-free). Min ₹250/year, max ₹1.5 lakh/year
benefitDescription.hi: बालिकाओं के लिए 8.2% ब्याज दर वाली बचत योजना (कर-मुक्त)। न्यूनतम ₹250/वर्ष, अधिकतम ₹1.5 लाख/वर्ष

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Account opened by parent/guardian for girl child below 10 years. Max 2 accounts per family.

benefitDescription.en: Guaranteed pension of ₹1,000-₹5,000/month after age 60 based on contribution
benefitDescription.hi: योगदान के आधार पर 60 वर्ष की आयु के बाद ₹1,000-₹5,000/माह गारंटीकृत पेंशन

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Must have a savings bank account. Not a taxpayer. Not covered under any statutory social security scheme.

benefitDescription.en: Collateral-free business loans: Shishu (up to ₹50K), Kishore (₹50K-₹5L), Tarun (₹5L-₹10L)
benefitDescription.hi: बिना गारंटी व्यापार ऋण: शिशु (₹50K तक), किशोर (₹50K-₹5L), तरुण (₹5L-₹10L)

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises. Must have a business plan.

benefitDescription.en: ₹15,000 toolkit subsidy + ₹500/day training stipend + loans up to ₹3 lakh at 5% interest
benefitDescription.hi: ₹15,000 टूलकिट सब्सिडी + ₹500/दिन प्रशिक्षण भत्ता + ₹3 लाख तक 5% ब्याज पर ऋण

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Traditional artisans and craftspeople working in 18 identified trades (carpenter, blacksmith, goldsmith, potter, etc.)

benefitDescription.en: ₹5,000 for first child (in 3 instalments) + ₹6,000 if second child is a girl
benefitDescription.hi: पहले बच्चे के लिए ₹5,000 (3 किस्तों में) + दूसरा बच्चा लड़की होने पर ₹6,000

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Pregnant and lactating women for first living child. Must register pregnancy at Anganwadi centre.

benefitDescription.en: Zero-balance bank account + ₹2 lakh accidental insurance + ₹30,000 life cover + RuPay debit card + ₹10,000 overdraft facility
benefitDescription.hi: जीरो बैलेंस बैंक खाता + ₹2 लाख दुर्घटना बीमा + ₹30,000 जीवन बीमा + RuPay डेबिट कार्ड + ₹10,000 ओवरड्राफ्ट

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Any Indian citizen without a bank account. One account per household.

benefitDescription.en: ₹2 lakh accidental insurance cover under PMSBY + access to various government welfare schemes
benefitDescription.hi: PMSBY के तहत ₹2 लाख दुर्घटना बीमा कवर + विभिन्न सरकारी कल्याण योजनाओं तक पहुंच

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Unorganised sector workers including construction workers, gig workers, street vendors, domestic workers, etc.

name.en: NSAP - Indira Gandhi Old Age Pension

benefitDescription.en: ₹200/month (age 60-79) or ₹500/month (age 80+) from central govt. States add their share.

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Must be below poverty line (BPL).

benefitDescription.en: ₹300/month for BPL widows aged 40-79. States add their share.
benefitDescription.hi: 40-79 वर्ष की बीपीएल विधवाओं को ₹300/माह। राज्य अपना हिस्सा जोड़ते हैं।

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Must be a widow and below poverty line.

benefitDescription.en: ₹300/month for BPL persons with 80%+ disability aged 18-79
benefitDescription.hi: 18-79 वर्ष की 80%+ विकलांगता वाले बीपीएल व्यक्तियों को ₹300/माह

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Must have 80% or more disability. Below poverty line.

benefitDescription.en: ₹2 lakh accidental death/disability insurance for just ₹20/year premium
benefitDescription.hi: मात्र ₹20/वर्ष प्रीमियम पर ₹2 लाख दुर्घटना मृत्यु/विकलांगता बीमा

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Must have a savings bank account with auto-debit facility.

benefitDescription.en: ₹2 lakh life insurance cover for ₹436/year premium. Covers death due to any cause.
benefitDescription.hi: ₹436/वर्ष प्रीमियम पर ₹2 लाख जीवन बीमा कवर। किसी भी कारण से मृत्यु पर।

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Must have a savings bank account. Coverage until age 55.

benefitDescription.en: Bank loans from ₹10 lakh to ₹1 crore for SC/ST and women entrepreneurs for greenfield enterprises
benefitDescription.hi: SC/ST और महिला उद्यमियों को नए उद्यम के लिए ₹10 लाख से ₹1 करोड़ तक बैंक ऋण

eligibility.additionalCriteria: SC/ST or women entrepreneur. Must be setting up a greenfield (new) enterprise in manufacturing, services, or trading.

benefitDescription.en: Working capital loan up to ₹10,000 (1st), ₹20,000 (2nd), ₹50,000 (3rd cycle) for street vendors with 7% interest subsidy
benefitDescription.hi: रेहड़ी-पटरी विक्रेताओं के लिए ₹10,000-₹50,000 तक कार्यशील पूंजी ऋण, 7% ब्याज सब्सिडी

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Must be a street vendor with vending certificate/ID from ULB or letter of recommendation.

name.en: MGNREGA (Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee)
name.hi: मनरेगा (महात्मा गांधी राष्ट्रीय ग्रामीण रोजगार गारंटी)

benefitDescription.en: 100 days guaranteed employment/year at ~₹370/day (varies by state). Unemployment allowance if work not provided.
benefitDescription.hi: ~₹370/दिन (राज्य अनुसार) पर 100 दिन गारंटीकृत रोजगार/वर्ष। काम न मिलने पर बेरोजगारी भत्ता।

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Any adult member of a rural household willing to do unskilled manual work. Must have a job card.

benefitDescription.en: 5 kg free foodgrains/person/month (rice, wheat, coarse grains) for priority households under NFSA
benefitDescription.hi: NFSA के तहत प्राथमिकता परिवारों को 5 किलो मुफ्त अनाज/व्यक्ति/माह (चावल, गेहूं, मोटे अनाज)

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Must have ration card under NFSA (Antyodaya or Priority Household). Extended till Dec 2028.

benefitDescription.en: Govt shares 25% of stipend (max ₹1,500/month) with employers for apprentices
benefitDescription.hi: सरकार शिक्षुओं के लिए नियोक्ताओं के साथ वेतन का 25% (अधिकतम ₹1,500/माह) साझा करती है

eligibility.additionalCriteria: ITI pass-outs, graduates, or candidates engaged in apprenticeship training at establishments.

benefitDescription.en: ₹75,000/year (Class 9-10) or ₹1,25,000/year (Class 11-12) for OBC/EBC/DNT students in top schools

eligibility.additionalCriteria: OBC, EBC, DNT, SC, ST students studying in top schools/colleges. Family income up to ₹2.5 lakh/year.

benefitDescription.en: ₹2,000/month to women heads of households
benefitDescription.hi: परिवार की महिला मुखिया को ₹2,000/माह

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Woman head of household in Karnataka. Must have BPL/Antyodaya/Priority ration card.

benefitDescription.en: 10 kg free rice/month per family (5 kg from centre + 5 kg from state) for BPL families
benefitDescription.hi: बीपीएल परिवारों को 10 किलो मुफ्त चावल/माह

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Must have BPL/Antyodaya ration card in Karnataka.

name.en: Shakti Scheme (Free Bus Travel for Women)
name.hi: शक्ति योजना (महिलाओं के लिए मुफ्त बस यात्रा)

benefitDescription.en: Free bus travel for all women in KSRTC and BMTC buses across Karnataka
benefitDescription.kn: ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ KSRTC ಮತ್ತು BMTC ಬಸ್‌ಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಮಹಿಳೆಯರಿಗೆ ಉಚಿತ ಬಸ್ ಪ್ರಯಾಣ
benefitDescription.hi: कर्नाटक की KSRTC और BMTC बसों में सभी महिलाओं को मुफ्त बस यात्रा

eligibility.additionalCriteria: All women can avail free travel in non-AC KSRTC and BMTC buses.

benefitDescription.en: Free electricity up to 200 units/month for one domestic connection per household
benefitDescription.hi: प्रति परिवार 200 यूनिट/माह तक मुफ्त बिजली

eligibility.additionalCriteria: One domestic electricity connection per household in Karnataka.

benefitDescription.en: ₹3,000/month (graduates) or ₹1,500/month (diploma holders) for unemployed youth for 2 years
benefitDescription.hi: बेरोजगार युवाओं को ₹3,000/माह (स्नातक) 2 वर्ष तक

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Graduate or diploma holder from Karnataka who is unemployed. Must register on Seva Sindhu portal.

benefitDescription.en: ₹1,000/month for eligible women heads of families
benefitDescription.hi: पात्र महिला परिवार मुखियाओं को ₹1,000/माह

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Women head of family in Tamil Nadu. Family should not be income taxpayers. Must have ration card.

name.en: Vidiyal Payanam (Free Bus Travel for Women)
name.hi: विडियल पयनम (महिलाओं के लिए मुफ्त बस यात्रा)

benefitDescription.en: Free bus travel for all women in Tamil Nadu government buses
benefitDescription.ta: தமிழ்நாடு அரசு பேருந்துகளில் அனைத்து பெண்களுக்கும் இலவச பயணம்
benefitDescription.hi: तमिलनाडु सरकारी बसों में सभी महिलाओं को मुफ्त बस यात्रा

eligibility.additionalCriteria: All women travelling in Tamil Nadu State Transport Corporation (TNSTC) buses.

benefitDescription.en: Free nutritious breakfast for government primary school students (Class 1-5)
benefitDescription.ta: அரசு ஆரம்பப் பள்ளி மாணவர்களுக்கு இலவச காலை உணவு
benefitDescription.hi: सरकारी प्राथमिक स्कूल छात्रों को मुफ्त पौष्टिक नाश्ता

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Students of government and government-aided primary schools in Tamil Nadu.

benefitDescription.en: ₹5 lakh health insurance cover per family (integrated with PMJAY)
benefitDescription.hi: प्रति परिवार ₹5 लाख स्वास्थ्य बीमा कवर

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Families with ration card in Tamil Nadu. Covers 1,000+ medical procedures.

benefitDescription.en: Free skill development and career guidance platform for college students and youth
benefitDescription.hi: कॉलेज छात्रों के लिए मुफ्त कौशल विकास और करियर मार्गदर्शन

eligibility.additionalCriteria: College students and recent graduates in Tamil Nadu.

benefitDescription.en: ₹25,000 total in 6 instalments from birth to graduation for girl child
benefitDescription.hi: बालिकाओं को जन्म से स्नातक तक 6 किस्तों में कुल ₹25,000

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Family annual income up to ₹3 lakh. Max 2 girls per family. Must be UP domicile.

name.en: UP Vridha Pension Yojana (Old Age Pension)

benefitDescription.en: ₹1,000/month pension for senior citizens aged 60+
benefitDescription.hi: 60+ वर्ष के वरिष्ठ नागरिकों को ₹1,000/माह पेंशन

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Must be BPL. Resident of Uttar Pradesh.

benefitDescription.en: ₹500/month pension for widows
benefitDescription.hi: विधवाओं को ₹500/माह पेंशन

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Widow and BPL resident of UP.

benefitDescription.en: ₹51,000 one-time grant for marriage of daughters of BPL families
benefitDescription.hi: बीपीएल परिवारों की बेटियों की शादी के लिए ₹51,000 एकमुश्त अनुदान

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Rural income up to ₹46,080/year, urban up to ₹56,460/year. UP domicile.

benefitDescription.en: ₹500/month pension for persons with 40%+ disability
benefitDescription.hi: 40%+ विकलांगता वाले व्यक्तियों को ₹500/माह पेंशन

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Must have 40%+ disability certificate. BPL resident of UP.

benefitDescription.en: ₹1,500/month (General/OBC) or ₹1,700/month (SC/ST) for women aged 25-60
benefitDescription.hi: महिलाओं को ₹1,500/माह (सामान्य/OBC) या ₹1,700/माह (SC/ST)

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Must be enrolled in Swasthya Sathi scheme. Not a government employee or pensioner.

benefitDescription.en: ₹1,000/year (K1 for school) + ₹25,000 one-time grant (K2) at age 18 for unmarried girls

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Unmarried girls aged 13-18. Family income up to ₹1.2 lakh/year. Must be enrolled in school.

benefitDescription.en: ₹5 lakh/year free health cover per family at empanelled hospitals
benefitDescription.bn: প্রতি পরিবারে ₹5 লক্ষ/বছর বিনামূল্যে স্বাস্থ্য কভার
benefitDescription.hi: प्रति परिवार ₹5 लाख/वर्ष मुफ्त स्वास्थ्य कवर

eligibility.additionalCriteria: All families in West Bengal. Card issued in woman's name.

benefitDescription.en: Free bicycle for students of Class 9-12 in government and aided schools
benefitDescription.hi: कक्षा 9-12 के छात्रों को मुफ्त साइकिल

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Students studying in Class 9-12 in government or government-aided schools in West Bengal.

benefitDescription.en: ₹25,000 one-time marriage grant for economically weaker families
benefitDescription.bn: অর্থনৈতিকভাবে দুর্বল পরিবারের জন্য ₹25,000 এককালীন বিবাহ অনুদান
benefitDescription.hi: आर्थिक रूप से कमजोर परिवारों को ₹25,000 एकमुश्त विवाह अनुदान

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Annual family income up to ₹1.5 lakh. Bride must be at least 18 years old.

benefitDescription.en: ₹50,000 one-time scholarship for unmarried girls on graduation completion
benefitDescription.hi: स्नातक पूर्ण करने पर अविवाहित लड़कियों को ₹50,000 एकमुश्त छात्रवृत्ति

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Unmarried girls who have completed graduation from a recognised Bihar university.

benefitDescription.en: Education loan up to ₹4 lakh at 4% interest (0% for girls, SC/ST, disabled)
benefitDescription.hi: ₹4 लाख तक शिक्षा ऋण 4% ब्याज पर (लड़कियों, SC/ST, दिव्यांग को 0%)

eligibility.additionalCriteria: 12th pass students from Bihar pursuing higher education.

benefitDescription.en: ₹3,000 for purchasing bicycle for Class 9 students
benefitDescription.hi: कक्षा 9 के छात्रों को साइकिल खरीदने के लिए ₹3,000

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Students studying in Class 9 in government schools in Bihar.

benefitDescription.en: ₹400/month pension for senior citizens aged 60+
benefitDescription.hi: 60+ वर्ष के वरिष्ठ नागरिकों को ₹400/माह पेंशन

eligibility.additionalCriteria: BPL resident of Bihar aged 60+.

benefitDescription.en: ₹600-₹1,500 for school uniform for students of Class 1-12

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Students of government schools in Bihar.

benefitDescription.en: Up to ₹25 lakh free health insurance per family per year at empanelled hospitals
benefitDescription.hi: पैनल अस्पतालों में प्रति परिवार प्रति वर्ष ₹25 लाख तक मुफ्त स्वास्थ्य बीमा

eligibility.additionalCriteria: All families of Rajasthan. Non-NFSA families pay ₹850/year premium. Now renamed Mukhyamantri Ayushman Arogya Yojana.

benefitDescription.en: ₹750-₹1,000/month for senior citizens aged 55+ (women) / 58+ (men)

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Women 55+, Men 58+. Annual income up to ₹48,000.

benefitDescription.en: ₹500/month (0-5 years) and ₹1,000/month (6-18 years) for orphan/destitute children + ₹2,000/year for clothing

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Orphaned, destitute or children of specific vulnerable categories. Guardian's income up to ₹1.2 lakh/year.

benefitDescription.en: Free scooty or ₹20,000/year scholarship for meritorious girls of special backward classes
benefitDescription.hi: विशेष पिछड़ा वर्ग की मेधावी छात्राओं को मुफ्त स्कूटी या ₹20,000/वर्ष छात्रवृत्ति

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Girls of special backward class (Gurjar, Raika, Banjara, Gadiya Lohar, Rebari). 12th pass with 50%+.

benefitDescription.en: Free smartphone with 3 years internet for women (Chiranjeevi beneficiary families)
benefitDescription.hi: महिलाओं को मुफ्त स्मार्टफोन 3 साल के इंटरनेट के साथ (चिरंजीवी लाभार्थी परिवार)

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Women head of Chiranjeevi beneficiary families or NREGA workers or widows/single women pensioners.

benefitDescription.en: ₹1,500/month for eligible women aged 21-60
benefitDescription.hi: 21-60 वर्ष की पात्र महिलाओं को ₹1,500/माह

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Married women of MP. Family income up to ₹2.5 lakh/year. Must not be a taxpayer or government employee.

benefitDescription.en: ₹8,000-₹10,000/month stipend for youth learning skills at establishments (75% by govt)
benefitDescription.hi: प्रतिष्ठानों में कौशल सीखने वाले युवाओं को ₹8,000-₹10,000/माह भत्ता (75% सरकार से)

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Youth of MP aged 18-29. Must be 12th pass or above. Must register on MMSKY portal.

benefitDescription.en: ₹1,43,000 total assurance certificates for girl child from birth to age 21. ₹1 lakh at age 21.
benefitDescription.hi: जन्म से 21 वर्ष तक बालिकाओं के लिए ₹1,43,000 कुल आश्वासन प्रमाण पत्र। 21 वर्ष पर ₹1 लाख।

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Girl child born in MP. Parents must be MP domicile. Not income taxpayers. Max 2 girls.

benefitDescription.en: Free electricity (100 units/month), ₹16,000 maternity benefit, last rites assistance for BPL families
benefitDescription.hi: बीपीएल परिवारों को मुफ्त बिजली (100 यूनिट/माह), ₹16,000 मातृत्व लाभ, अंत्येष्टि सहायता

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Unorganised workers registered under Sambal portal in MP. Must have Sambal card.

benefitDescription.en: ₹600/month pension for senior citizens aged 60+ (BPL/destitute)
benefitDescription.hi: 60+ वर्ष के बीपीएल/निराश्रित वरिष्ठ नागरिकों को ₹600/माह पेंशन

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Must be BPL. Resident of Madhya Pradesh.

benefitDescription.en: ₹1,500/month for women aged 21-65 from economically weaker families
benefitDescription.hi: 21-65 वर्ष की आर्थिक रूप से कमजोर परिवारों की महिलाओं को ₹1,500/माह

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Women of Maharashtra. Family annual income up to ₹2.5 lakh. Must have domicile certificate.

name.en: Mahatma Jyotiba Phule Jan Arogya Yojana
name.mr: महात्मा ज्योतिबा फुले जन आरोग्य योजना
name.hi: महात्मा ज्योतिबा फुले जन आरोग्य योजना

benefitDescription.en: ₹5 lakh free health cover per family per year (integrated with PMJAY)
benefitDescription.mr: प्रति कुटुंब प्रति वर्ष ₹5 लाख मोफत आरोग्य विमा
benefitDescription.hi: प्रति परिवार प्रति वर्ष ₹5 लाख मुफ्त स्वास्थ्य कवर

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Families with yellow/orange ration card in Maharashtra. Covers 1,000+ medical procedures.

benefitDescription.en: ₹1,01,000 total in 5 instalments from birth to age 18 for girls of economically weaker families
benefitDescription.mr: आर्थिक दुर्बल कुटुंबातील मुलींना जन्मापासून ते 18 वर्षांपर्यंत 5 हप्त्यांमध्ये एकूण ₹1,01,000
benefitDescription.hi: आर्थिक रूप से कमजोर परिवारों की लड़कियों को जन्म से 18 वर्ष तक 5 किस्तों में कुल ₹1,01,000

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Girls born in families with yellow/orange ration card in Maharashtra.

name.en: Shravan Bal Seva Rajya Nivruttivetan Yojana
name.mr: श्रावण बाळ सेवा राज्य निवृत्तीवेतन योजना
name.hi: श्रावण बाल सेवा राज्य पेंशन योजना

benefitDescription.en: ₹1,500/month pension for destitute senior citizens aged 65+
benefitDescription.hi: 65+ वर्ष के निराश्रित वरिष्ठ नागरिकों को ₹1,500/माह

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Annual income below ₹21,000. Resident of Maharashtra.

benefitDescription.en: ₹2.5 lakh housing subsidy for SC/Neo-Buddhist families
benefitDescription.hi: SC/नवबौद्ध परिवारों को ₹2.5 लाख आवास सब्सिडी

eligibility.additionalCriteria: SC/Neo-Buddhist families of Maharashtra who are homeless or live in kutcha house.

benefitDescription.en: ₹4,000/month pension for elderly (60+), widows, disabled, weavers, toddy tappers

eligibility.additionalCriteria: BPL residents of AP aged 60+, widows, disabled persons, weavers, toddy tappers.

benefitDescription.en: ₹15,000/year to mothers of school-going children (Class 1-12) to prevent dropouts
benefitDescription.hi: स्कूल जाने वाले बच्चों (कक्षा 1-12) की माताओं को ₹15,000/वर्ष

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Mothers/guardians of children studying in government/aided schools in AP. Must have ration card.

benefitDescription.en: Full fee reimbursement for ITI/Polytechnic/Degree/PG students from economically weaker families
benefitDescription.te: ఆర్థికంగా బలహీన కుటుంబాల విద్యార్థులకు పూర్తి ఫీజు రీయింబర్స్‌మెంట్
benefitDescription.hi: आर्थिक रूप से कमजोर परिवारों के ITI/डिग्री/PG छात्रों को पूर्ण शुल्क प्रतिपूर्ति

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Students from families with annual income up to ₹2.5 lakh studying in AP.

benefitDescription.en: ₹20,000/year investment support for farmers (₹13,500 state + ₹6,000 PM-KISAN)
benefitDescription.hi: किसानों को ₹20,000/वर्ष निवेश सहायता

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Land-owning farmers of Andhra Pradesh.

benefitDescription.en: ₹75,000 over 4 years (₹18,750/year) for women aged 45-60 from SC/ST/BC/Minority
benefitDescription.hi: 45-60 वर्ष की SC/ST/BC/अल्पसंख्यक महिलाओं को 4 वर्षों में ₹75,000

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Women of SC/ST/BC/Minority communities in AP aged 45-60.

benefitDescription.en: ₹12,000/year per acre for farmers (₹6,000 per season in 2 instalments)
benefitDescription.hi: किसानों को प्रति एकड़ ₹12,000/वर्ष

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Land-owning farmers in Telangana. Previously Rythu Bandhu.

benefitDescription.en: ₹1,000/month for elderly, widows, weavers, toddy tappers. ₹1,500/month for disabled.

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Elderly 57+, widows, disabled, weavers, toddy tappers, beedi workers of Telangana.

benefitDescription.en: ₹1,00,016 one-time marriage assistance for women from SC/ST/BC/Minority/EBC families
benefitDescription.hi: SC/ST/BC/अल्पसंख्यक परिवारों की महिलाओं को ₹1,00,016 विवाह सहायता

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Women from SC/ST/BC/Minority/EBC families in Telangana at the time of marriage.

benefitDescription.en: Free 2BHK houses for economically weaker sections in urban and rural areas
benefitDescription.hi: आर्थिक रूप से कमजोर वर्गों को मुफ्त 2BHK आवास

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Economically weaker families in Telangana without a pucca house.

benefitDescription.en: Full tuition fee reimbursement for SC/ST/BC/Minority/EBC students in higher education
benefitDescription.hi: SC/ST/BC/अल्पसंख्यक छात्रों को उच्च शिक्षा में पूर्ण शुल्क प्रतिपूर्ति

eligibility.additionalCriteria: SC/ST/BC/EBC/Minority students. Family income up to ₹2 lakh. Must study in Telangana.

benefitDescription.en: ₹1,600/month pension for elderly, widows, disabled, and other vulnerable groups
benefitDescription.hi: वृद्ध, विधवा, दिव्यांग को ₹1,600/माह पेंशन

eligibility.additionalCriteria: BPL/economically weaker residents of Kerala. Multiple pension categories available.

benefitDescription.en: Up to ₹6 lakh assistance for house construction for homeless families
benefitDescription.ml: ഭവനരഹിത കുടുംബങ്ങൾക്ക് വീട് നിർമ്മാണത്തിന് ₹6 ലക്ഷം വരെ സഹായം
benefitDescription.hi: बेघर परिवारों को मकान निर्माण के लिए ₹6 लाख तक सहायता

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Homeless or living in dilapidated house in Kerala. Selected through local body verification.

benefitDescription.en: ₹300-₹1,000/month scholarship for orphan students studying in schools/colleges

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Orphan students (one or both parents deceased) studying in government/aided institutions in Kerala.

benefitDescription.en: Subsidized dairy units and support for milk farmers to boost milk production
benefitDescription.ml: ക്ഷീര കർഷകർക്ക് സബ്‌സിഡി ഡയറി യൂണിറ്റുകളും പിന്തുണയും
benefitDescription.hi: दूध उत्पादन बढ़ाने के लिए सब्सिडी डेयरी इकाइयां

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Dairy farmers and those willing to start dairy farming in Kerala.

benefitDescription.en: ₹5 lakh health insurance per family (integrated with PMJAY for eligible families)
benefitDescription.hi: प्रति परिवार ₹5 लाख स्वास्थ्य बीमा

eligibility.additionalCriteria: BPL/eligible families in Kerala with ration card.

benefitDescription.en: ₹10,000/year (Class 9-10) or ₹15,000/year (Class 11-12) scholarship for girl students

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Girl students of Gujarat studying in Class 9-12 in government or private schools.

benefitDescription.en: ₹1,10,000 total in 3 instalments: ₹4,000 (Class 1), ₹6,000 (Class 9), ₹1,00,000 (age 18)

eligibility.additionalCriteria: First two daughters of a family in Gujarat. Must be domicile of Gujarat.

benefitDescription.en: Crop loss compensation: up to ₹25,000/hectare (33-60% loss) or ₹50,000/hectare (60%+ loss)
benefitDescription.gu: પાક નુકસાન વળતર: ₹25,000/હેક્ટર (33-60% નુકસાન) અથવા ₹50,000/હેક્ટર (60%+ નુકસાન)

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Farmers in Gujarat affected by natural calamities. Max 4 hectares.

benefitDescription.en: Tools and equipment kits worth ₹4,000-₹25,000 for SC families to start self-employment
benefitDescription.gu: SC કુટુંબોને સ્વરોજગાર માટે ₹4,000-₹25,000 ના સાધન કિટ
benefitDescription.hi: SC परिवारों को स्व-रोजगार के लिए ₹4,000-₹25,000 मूल्य के उपकरण किट

eligibility.additionalCriteria: SC families in Gujarat with BPL status. For self-employment activities.

benefitDescription.en: ₹25,000/year scholarship for students (Class 11-12) in science stream
benefitDescription.hi: विज्ञान संकाय के छात्रों (कक्षा 11-12) को ₹25,000/वर्ष छात्रवृत्ति

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Students studying science stream in Class 11-12 in Gujarat. Must have scored 50%+ in Class 10.
